title: AutoRituals
description: An automated world-event plugin that spawns rituals at random coordinates. Players must find and defend these sites to claim loot.
body:
# 🔥 Auto Rituals
## Automated Events. Legendary Loot. High Stakes.

AutoRituals is a high-performance event plugin that creates spontaneous "King of the Hill" battlegrounds. It automatically spawns mystical ritual sites at random coordinates, challenging players to find and defend the altar to claim legendary rewards.

## ⚡ Key Features
> - **Automated Cycles:** Handles location scouting, altar construction, and terrain cleanup automatically.
> 
> - **In-Game Loot GUI:** Manage rewards instantly by left clicking and right clicking items into the /ritual gui.
> 
> - **Smart Restoration:** Automatically heals the world (including trees and structures) once the ritual ends.
> 
> - **Grief Protection:** Prevents block breaking or placing within the ritual zone during active events.
> 
> - **Global Alerts:** Features a synced BossBar, in-game broadcasts, and Discord Webhook support.
> 
> - **Console Ready:** Full support for forcestart, forcestop, and settings directly from the console.

## 🛠️ Essential Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| /ritual time | None | Check the countdown. |
| /ritual coords | None | Get the X, Y, Z of the currently active ritual. |
| /ritual gui | ritual.admin | Open the loot editor. |
| /ritual reload | ritual.admin | Reload the config. |
| /ritual stop | ritual.admin | Instantly cancel the active ritual and clean up. |
| /ritual options | ritual.admin | Change radius, duration, and frequency settings. |
| /ritual toggle | ritual.admin | Enable or disable the automatic ritual timer. |
| /ritual reload | ritual.admin | Reload the plugin configuration and data files. |

## 📜 Config

```
settings:
  enabled: true
  radius: 10
  duration: 30
  interval: 360
  min-range: 5000
  max-range: 15000
  webhook-url: "PASTE_WEBHOOK"
  ping-role: "1234567890"
  bossbar-enabled: true

messages:
  discord-start: "{role} 🔥 **ʀɪᴛᴜᴀʟ ʙᴇɢᴜɴ!**\n📦 **ɪᴛᴇᴍ:** {item}\n📍 **ʟᴏᴄᴀᴛɪᴏɴ:** {x}, {y}, {z}"
  discord-end: "{role} ✅ **RITUAL COMPLETE!**\n🏆 **{item}** has been forged."
items: {}
```
